# Luis Llamas

> A comprehensive resource for engineering, computer science, and design education with interactive tools, free courses, and project portfolios.

Luis Llamas is a Spanish educational platform offering in-depth courses, tutorials, and interactive playgrounds for microcontrollers, IoT, embedded systems, programming languages, and 3D design. The site combines practical hands-on learning with reference materials suitable for beginners through intermediate learners.

## Key Topics

- Arduino
- ESP32
- ESP8266
- Raspberry Pi
- Linux
- Python
- C#
- C++
- JavaScript
- Node.js
- IoT
- Embedded Systems
- 3D Printing
- CAD Design
- Web Development

## Courses & Learning Paths

- [Cursos - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/cursos): Free courses catalog covering C#, C++, Python, JavaScript
- [Curso ESP8266 / ESP32 - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/curso-esp8266-esp32): IoT course for ESP8266, ESP32, ESP32-S2, ESP32-S3 SoCs
- [Tutoriales de Arduino - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/tutoriales-arduino): Arduino and microcontroller tutorials for ESP32, ESP8266
- [Curso Raspberry Pi / Linux - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/curso-raspberry-pi): Linux and Raspberry Pi course with setup and command-line
- [Curso introducción a la programación - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/curso-programacion): Beginner programming course with Visual Studio, Node.js
- [Curso del sistema binario - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/curso-binario): Binary system fundamentals course covering ASCII, UTF-8
- [Curso impresión 3D - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/curso-impresion-3d): 3D printing and CAD design course for FFF printing

## Tutorials & Beginner Guides

- [Desde cero - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/aprende-desde-cero): Beginner guides and step-by-step tutorials for programming
- [Cheatsheets - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/cheatsheets): Quick reference sheets for Python, C#, C++, Java programming

## Interactive Tools & Playgrounds

- [Playgrounds - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/playgrounds): Interactive tools: Arduino simulator, circuit tools, CSS generators

## Content Categories

- [Categoria Programación](https://www.luisllamas.es/programacion): Programming category: WPF, ASP.NET, Vue.js, web frameworks
- [Categoria Ingenieria](https://www.luisllamas.es/ingenieria): Engineering category: microcontrollers, IoT devices, boards
- [Categoria Electrónica](https://www.luisllamas.es/electronica): Electronics category: PCB design, Arduino, components
- [Categoria Informática](https://www.luisllamas.es/informatica): Computer science category: Node.js, tools, web technologies
- [Categoria Diseño](https://www.luisllamas.es/diseno): Design category: 3D modeling, CAD, design tools and reviews
- [Categoria Proyectos](https://www.luisllamas.es/proyectos): Projects portfolio: Arduino, ESP32, robotics, DIY electronics

## Portfolio & Creative Work

- [Portfolio 3d - Luis Llamas](https://www.luisllamas.es/renders): 3D rendering portfolio with Blender, 3ds Max, Inventor work

## Core Pages

- [Luis Llamas - Ingeniería, informática y diseño (Zaragoza)](https://www.luisllamas.es): Homepage for Luis Llamas' engineering, CS, and design blog
- [Luis Llamas - Engineering, Computer Science, and Design](https://www.luisllamas.es/en): English homepage for engineering, CS, and design content
